items.title: Joe Ward: The unluckiest man in Irish boxing
items.description: Joe Ward had the world at his feet. He was an amateur boxing sensation, he had a golden future laid out before him. Until disaster struck, over and over again.

items.title: Rockets march on after easy win while Buttler makes history in The Hundred
items.description: Trent Rockets extended their lead at the top of The Hundred table with a near-perfect performance that secured their fifth win in six games, leaving Birmingham Phoenix rooted to the bottom.

items.title: Arsenal beaten by Real Betis in Dublin friendly
items.description: Arsenal produced a sloppy performance as they were beaten 3-1 by LaLiga side Real Betis in a pre-season friendly in Dublin.

items.title: Castleford head coach Carr to miss the game against Hull KR
items.description: Castleford Tigers head coach Ryan Carr will not be in attendance at the Hull KR game due to personal reasons.

items.title: Infantino sorry for errors but stays Fifa president
items.description: Gianni Infantino will remain as Fifa president after receiving the backing of senior executives, but "sincerely apologises" for errors made in his controversial private investment plans.

items.title: Everton sign midfielder Norgaard from Arsenal
items.description: Everton sign Denmark midfielder Christian Norgaard from Arsenal on a two-year contract for a reported fee of £7m.

items.title: Defender Walker 'at ease' with England retirement
items.description: Former England defender Kyle Walker says he is "at ease" with his decision to quit international football and hoped it could lead to an extended club career, similar to that enjoyed by James Milner.

items.title: Real Madrid improve Vinicius Jr offer amid Arsenal interest
items.description: Real Madrid have improved their contract offer to Vinicius Junior amid interest from Arsenal.

items.title: Infantino remains FIFA president following crisis meeting
items.description: Under-fire FIFA president Gianni Infantino has shaken off calls to resign - for now - with the backing of the governing body's leaders, though apologised for "mistakes" in his botched attempts to sell off a stake in the World Cup.

items.title: Pakistan end eight-match away Test losing streak ahead of England clash
items.description: Pakistan ended their eight-match away Test losing streak in emphatic fashion on Wednesday, securing an eight-wicket victory over the West Indies.

items.title: Norrie notches another win in Montreal as Fonseca marks return in style
items.description: British No 2 Cameron Norrie claimed a comfortable victory at the National Bank Open in Montreal to set up a third-round meeting with Katie Boulter's new husband Alex De Minaur.

items.title: Real Madrid agree £120m Diomande deal - Thursday's gossip
items.description: Real Madrid reach £120m agreement for Yan Diomande, Liverpool explore move for Ibrahim Mbaye and Aston Villa reach agreement to sign Matteo Ruggeri.
